review_candidates.title: EXPEDITED RECRUITMENT - Supply Chain Associate - Procurement and Logistics
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope Responsibilities Under general guidance of the Chief of Mission (CoM), the overall supervision of the Head of Resources Management and Supply Chain Officer and, the direct s upervision of the Senior Supply Chain Assistant - Logistic is responsible for the following: Assist the Supply Chain Officer in the planning of procurement activities and analysing of purchasing trends. Identify Supply Chain bottlenecks and propose the way to fill in the gaps. Plan and prepare procurement actions and analyze procurement requests, identify service providers, evaluate information regarding vendor’s performance regarding quality, prices delivery of equipment in respect of organizations best interests. Solicit bids or quotations, analyzing them for conformity to specified requirements, conduct appraisals and select suppliers, and confirm terms of payment. Prepare purchase orders and ensure receiving authorization by CoM, Supply Chain Officer according to the IOM Procurement Manual. Participate in the negociation ofcertain conditions of contracts in full compliance with IOM rules and regulations. Monitor that procurement transactions are tracked to facilitate timely delivery and shorter procurement lead times. Monitor that payments for goods and services ordered are made in timely manner and according to IOM Procurement guidelines. Ensure that the “Goods Receipt Notes” are acknowledged by the requisitioner upon services/works are rendered and/or the goods are received. Logistics Monitor and track office supplies such as stationary and cleaning materials on a monthly basis. Prepare and submit to Finance Unit all payments related to Logistics services such as Utility Bills, Internet Bills, and Landlines Bills at the end of every month. Fleet management – ensure that vehicle movement requests, both IOM and rented vehicles are supported and each vehicle has a vehicle logbook allocated. Ensure vehicle data is uploaded into the system in a timely and accurate manner to be able to generate monthly utilization and fuel consumption reports. Ensure Registration of all IOM assets and/or disposal with accordance with IOM procedures and regulations, and make sure that all the needed forms are signed by the staff upon assigning/releasing assets. Conduct and follow-up the fuel consumption for generators and track usage via log sheet. Communicate with the generators’ technician with regards to the generator's maintenance. Perform any other duties as assigned by Supply Chain Officer. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education University degree in Procurement, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience, or Completed High School degree from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Professional experience with specific focus on local/international procurement, clearing & forwarding, VAT, GoI laws and regulations, Fleet management experience and insurance management Experience in inventory/stock/supplies management. Experience working with an international organization or NGO in the procurement section Languages For this position, fluency in English, Kurdish and Arabic is required (oral and written). IOM's official languages are English, French and Spanish. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

The role involves assisting with heritage research, site documentation, conservation programs, community engagement, exhibitions, educational initiatives, and coordination with relevant cultural institutions and stakeholders. The position is suitable for candidates with experience or education in cultural heritage, archaeology, history, anthropology, museum studies, conservation, cultural management, or related fields. Previous experience working with heritage sites, museums, archives, or cultural institutions is an advantage. Key Responsibilities Support the planning and implementation of cultural heritage preservation and management activities. Assist with identifying, documenting, and recording cultural heritage assets and resources. Conduct research on historical sites, buildings, artifacts, traditions, and cultural practices. Assist with heritage surveys, site assessments, documentation, and fieldwork. Maintain accurate records of heritage sites, objects, photographs, drawings, reports, and related documentation. Assist with cataloging and maintaining heritage collections and archival materials. Support the preparation of heritage assessments, reports, inventories, and research summaries. Assist with documenting the historical, architectural, archaeological, and cultural significance of heritage assets. Support conservation and preservation projects under the direction of qualified specialists. Monitor the condition of heritage sites, structures, artifacts, and cultural resources. Report damage, deterioration, unauthorized activity, or other potential risks affecting heritage assets. Assist with coordinating maintenance and conservation activities with contractors, consultants, specialists, and relevant authorities. Support archaeological, architectural, historical, or cultural research projects when required. Assist with collecting field data, photographs, measurements, maps, and other project information. Support the development and maintenance of heritage databases and digital records. Assist with preparing documentation for heritage permits, approvals, registrations, and related processes where applicable. Coordinate with museums, cultural institutions, government departments, research organizations, consultants, and community groups. Assist with organizing exhibitions, cultural programs, educational activities, lectures, workshops, and heritage events. Support the preparation of interpretive materials, brochures, displays, signage, presentations, and digital content. Assist with developing public awareness initiatives related to cultural heritage and preservation. Communicate with visitors, researchers, community members, contractors, and other stakeholders professionally. Provide accurate general information about heritage sites, collections, history, and cultural significance within the approved scope of information. Support guided heritage activities and educational programs when required. Assist with coordinating cultural heritage events, public programs, and community engagement activities. Research traditional crafts, customs, oral histories, local traditions, and intangible cultural heritage where applicable. Assist with recording interviews, oral histories, community knowledge, and cultural documentation according to approved procedures. Support digitization projects involving photographs, documents, maps, manuscripts, and other heritage materials. Maintain organized digital and physical heritage files. Assist with tracking project schedules, budgets, procurement activities, and documentation when required. Prepare meeting notes, project updates, correspondence, and administrative reports. Maintain confidentiality regarding sensitive cultural information, archaeological locations, private collections, and stakeholder information where required. Follow heritage protection standards, site safety procedures, ethical research practices, and applicable UAE laws and regulations. Perform other cultural heritage, research, conservation, and administrative duties as assigned. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Cultural Heritage, Archaeology, History, Anthropology, Museum Studies, Architecture, Conservation, Cultural Management, or a related field is preferred. Master's degree or specialized heritage qualification is an advantage. Previous experience in cultural heritage, museums, archaeology, historical research, conservation, archives, or cultural institutions is preferred. Strong knowledge of heritage preservation and documentation principles. Understanding of historical, archaeological, architectural, and cultural research methods. Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills. Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to conduct fieldwork and document heritage sites and objects systematically. Good organizational and project coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple research, documentation, and heritage activities. Good understanding of cultural sensitivity and ethical heritage practices. Ability to work effectively with researchers, government authorities, consultants, community groups, and cultural organizations. Good computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Experience with heritage databases, GIS, digital archives, cataloging systems, or documentation software is an advantage. Knowledge of conservation terminology and heritage-management practices is beneficial. Strong presentation and public communication skills. Professional, respectful, and culturally sensitive approach. Ability to work in offices, museums, heritage sites, and outdoor field environments when required. Willingness to travel to heritage sites and project locations when necessary. Fluency in English is preferred; knowledge of Arabic or additional languages is an advantage. Knowledge of UAE history, archaeology, architecture, traditional culture, and national heritage is an advantage. Familiarity with UAE cultural heritage policies and regulatory requirements is an advantage. Relevant professional heritage, museum, archaeology, or conservation certification is an advantage. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. Professional and culturally focused working environment. Opportunity to contribute to the preservation and promotion of cultural heritage. On-the-job training and practical experience in heritage management. Exposure to historical sites, cultural collections, conservation projects, and heritage programs. Opportunities to develop research, documentation, conservation, and project coordination skills. Career development opportunities within cultural heritage, museums, archaeology, conservation, and cultural management. Training and professional development opportunities. Opportunities to work with cultural institutions, researchers, government authorities, and heritage professionals. Employment benefits in accordance with UAE labour regulations.

review_candidates.title: Comptable - International
review_candidates.description: 🚙 À propos : Lancée en 2012, Hiflow est une plateforme digitale spécialisée dans la livraison à l'unité de voitures , grâce à un important réseau de chauffeurs indépendants. Nous sommes le principal prestataire de livraison de nombreuses entreprises : sociétés de leasing, loueurs de voitures, constructeurs automobiles, concessionnaires automobiles, etc. Ex : Tesla, Europcar, Ayvens (Société Générale), Arval (BNP). Leader en France, présents en Espagne, Belgique et en Italie, nous sommes un acteur majeur du secteur de la mobilité , un secteur en pleine transition : digitalisation, augmentation de la location et augmentation des véhicules électriques. En quelques chiffres, Hiflow c’est : plus de 300 clients grands comptes ; plus de 100 000 véhicules déplacés par an ; plus de 5000 chauffeurs actifs ; En tant que Comptable Général.e - International, et sous la responsabilité directe d’Alexa, RAF, tu rejoins une équipe Finance déjà composée de 4 personnes : un DAF, une RAF, une comptable France et un responsable recouvrement et facturation. 📌 Ton rôle : Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous internalisons la comptabilité de nos filiales (Espagne, Italie, Belgique), aujourd'hui gérée par des cabinets locaux. Ton rôle ? Piloter cette transition en rapatriant, centralisant et harmonisant nos process financiers, pour structurer notre développement européen. 🎯 Plus précisément, tes missions seront : Tenue Comptable & Gestion de la Trésorerie 💶 Comptabilité générale : Tu assures la saisie, le contrôle des écritures (achats, ventes, banques) et la réalisation des rapprochements bancaires. Opérations bancaires : Tu suis et enregistres avec rigueur l'ensemble de nos flux financiers internationaux. Facturation chauffeurs : Tu as la charge de la production des factures de nos chauffeurs partenaires, ainsi que de leur comptabilisation et de l'exécution des paiements. Clôtures, Fiscalité & Performance Financière 📊 Clôtures périodiques : Tu participes activement aux travaux de révision des comptes et tu justifies les soldes lors de nos clôtures mensuelles et annuelles. Conformité locale : Tu aides à la préparation des déclarations fiscales et sociales courantes (TVA, impôts locaux, etc.) en respectant les spécificités de chaque pays. Relation avec les cabinets : Tu prépares les éléments à transmettre à nos experts-comptables et fiscalistes locaux, tu suis les échanges et tu intègres leurs ajustements. Contrôle financier : Tu analyses les écarts entre le budget et le réel, participes à la création des reportings mensuels de performance pour la Direction, et tu apportes ton aide sur la préparation des budgets et forecasts des filiales. Recouvrement & Support Opérationnel 🤝 Recouvrement international : En étroite collaboration avec Nicolas (notre Responsable Recouvrement et Facturation), tu suis l'encours de nos clients internationaux. Tu identifies les retards, participes activement aux relances (téléphone, email, courrier) et assures la bonne tenue des historiques de paiement. Traitement des demandes : Tu gères les tickets financiers au quotidien pour garantir un support fluide et réactif aux autres équipes. 🎉 Pourquoi nous rejoindre : Tu joueras un rôle clé dans notre développement à l’international: l’occasion d’apprendre beaucoup et d’avoir un impact fort ! Tu es à l’aise à l’oral et à l’écrit en Anglais, pour échanger avec nos partenaires, nos clients et nos collègues à travers l’Europe.
